title: cc/cx custom params
description: Named intent bundles for the cc (claude) and cx (codex) shell wrappers. See README.md.

_help.description: Free-text note; ignored by the tooling.

params.description: Map of param name -> intent bundle.

param.description: One named bundle. Combine any of the fields below; an empty object is a valid no-op placeholder.

description.description: Shown next to the name in tab-completion.

aliases.description: Extra names that resolve to this param (e.g. a short form: opus48 aliased as "o"). They inherit the param's `harnesses` scoping and show in completion marked as aliases.

harnesses.description: Which tools this param applies to. Omit = applies to all. cc => "claude", cx => "codex". On a tool it doesn't apply to, the name is not recognized (it passes through).

model.description: Model to use. cc => --model <v>; cx => -m <v>. Note claude model aliases are not valid codex models.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. cx => -c model_reasoning_effort=<v>; cc has no effort flag (no-op).

mcpServers.description: MCP servers to make available, keyed by server name (the MCP convention). cc => merged into --mcp-config; cx => -c mcp_servers.<name>.* overrides. A remote server uses type+url (claude) — codex infers transport from url and ignores type.

env.description: Environment variables exported for the run (both tools).

args.description: Escape hatch: literal flags appended for each tool.

mcpServer.description: Standard MCP server definition: command+args(+env) for stdio, or type+url for remote.
